name: The Silent Choir
intro: The seraph's door closes behind you on silence — a silence so complete it has weight. You stand in a cathedral of ash, where a choir once sang a seraph down and something sang it back up again.

rooms.name: The Silent Choir - The Nave of Ash
rooms.description: Pews of grey ash fill the nave, and every one of them is occupied. North, the choir screen is shut, its carved angels' faces chiselled away.

rooms.name: The Silent Choir - The Broken Organ
rooms.description: The cathedral organ fills the transept, its pipes split and bleeding dust. Every so often it wheezes a note that makes your teeth ache. Stairs lead north to the choir loft.

rooms.name: The Silent Choir - The Choir Loft
rooms.description: The choir loft is empty but for a hundred white robes, folded neatly on the benches, and the thing that silenced them.

waves.text: Ashen acolytes rise from the pews, their mouths sewn shut!
The broken organ wheezes, and mourning wisps pour from its pipes!
The wisps come again, wailing the hymn backwards!

gates.text: The choir screen swings open on the transept.
The loft stair is clear — and something above has stopped listening.

boss.text: Serathiel the Fallen turns from the empty choir. Where its face was there is only a mouth. 'They sang,' it says, 'and no one came. Now nothing sings.'
